attributes.board_name: Arkansas Board of Examiners in Counseling

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops by qualified professionals from state and/or nationally recognized training programs; presenting (2 h per initial hour); regionally accredited academic coursework (15 h per credit hour); teaching a new course or publishing (10 h); leadership service in professional associations or the board (10 h); Volunteer Health Care Act service (1 h per 8 h)
rules.alternatives: Taking the NCE or NCMHCE and meeting the national pass score substitutes for CE clock hours.
rules.audit_note: A percentage of renewals may be audited (up to one-third of file numbers each year); keep CE documentation for the previous 24 months.

topics.who: Board-approved supervisors; 3 of the 6 from Board-recognized state associations or an Arkansas university program

rules.notes: Ethics must fit the license; other hours counseling in nature per statement of intent. Dual LPC/LMFT holders: 24 h total, 3 ethics, rest balanced. Licenses expire May 31 of the renewal year (biennial).
